metadata.title: Dev Research Scout - Sources
metadata.description: Multi-source research idea mining: arXiv, HF Papers, Semantic Scholar, Papers with Code, conferences, industry research blogs, and curator newsletters.
metadata.currency_review: 2026-07-11 Jul-2026 verified sweep (OpenAlex mandate date corrected to 2026-02-13; Elicit pricing overhaul; ResearchRabbit acquisition date corrected to 2025-05-08)

attribution.arxiv: Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability.

dead_or_changed.name: Papers with Code
dead_or_changed.change: Shut down by Meta in July 2025; paperswithcode.com now 301-redirects to Hugging Face Trending Papers
dead_or_changed.replacement: HF Papers (huggingface.co/papers) + GitHub repo signal via research-git + Emergent Mind (emergentmind.com)

dead_or_changed.name: Distill.pub
dead_or_changed.change: Indefinite hiatus since 2021; confirmed no resumption through May 2026; archive only
dead_or_changed.replacement: HF Blog (huggingface.co/blog) for visual explainers; Lilian Weng Lil'Log for synthesis

dead_or_changed.name: arXiv export API endpoint
dead_or_changed.change: Stricter 429 enforcement from Feb 2026; hard 1 request / 3s, single connection
dead_or_changed.replacement: Same endpoint; enforce 3s delay in all query scripts

dead_or_changed.name: OpenAlex
dead_or_changed.change: API key mandatory since 2026-02-13 (verify at openalex.org/pricing as of 2026-07-11); polite-pool email param retired. Keyed requests get $1/day free credit (~usual research volume); unkeyed requests get $0.10/day then 409s.
dead_or_changed.replacement: Same service; register for free API key at openalex.org/settings/api

dead_or_changed.name: Connected Papers
dead_or_changed.change: Paid tier introduced 2025; free plan limited to 50 inputs/searches
dead_or_changed.replacement: OpenAlex citation graph (free) or Semantic Scholar's graph API for bulk use

dead_or_changed.name: ICLR / OpenReview
dead_or_changed.change: OpenReview API v2 mandatory; v1 deprecated; all 2026 venues on v2
dead_or_changed.replacement: Same venue; use OpenReview API v2 endpoints

dead_or_changed.name: Andrej Karpathy blog
dead_or_changed.change: URL moved from karpathy.github.io to karpathy.bearblog.dev/blog/ (also karpathy.substack.com)

dead_or_changed.name: Anthropic Research blog
dead_or_changed.change: Expanded: added Alignment Science Blog (alignment.anthropic.com, Mar 2026) and Frontier Red Team blog (red.anthropic.com)
dead_or_changed.replacement: Additive — original blog still active; see new sources in industry_research_blogs

dead_or_changed.name: Semantic Scholar API
dead_or_changed.change: Key now officially recommended; ~1 RPS authenticated; exponential backoff required
dead_or_changed.replacement: Same service; register for API key at semanticscholar.org/product/api

hf_papers.name: Hugging Face Papers Trending

semantic_scholar.name: Semantic Scholar API

semantic_scholar.access: free with rate limit; key required for higher tier

semantic_scholar.name: Semantic Scholar Search
semantic_scholar.relevance: Web UI for paper discovery and citation traversal.

semantic_scholar.name: OpenAlex
semantic_scholar.relevance: Open catalog of scholarly works; complementary to Semantic Scholar. API key mandatory since 2026-02-13; keyed = $1/day free credit, unkeyed = $0.10/day then 409s.
semantic_scholar.status_note: API key mandatory since 2026-02-13 (verify at openalex.org/pricing as of 2026-07-11); polite-pool email param retired. Usage-based pricing: singleton lookups free, list/search/semantic calls metered; $1/day free credit with a key covers normal research use.

semantic_scholar.name: Connected Papers
semantic_scholar.relevance: Visual prior-work and derivative-work exploration. Free plan limited to 50 inputs/searches since 2025.
semantic_scholar.status_note: Paid tier introduced 2025; free plan limited to 50 inputs/searches.

papers_with_code.name: Papers with Code data archive (DEAD SOURCE — historical only)
papers_with_code.relevance: Papers with Code was shut down by Meta in July 2025; paperswithcode.com now 301-redirects to Hugging Face Trending Papers. This GitHub snapshot is the frozen, no-longer-updated historical dataset. Use ONLY for pre-July-2025 method/benchmark lookups. Do NOT treat as a live reproducibility signal. Live replacement: HF Papers + direct GitHub repo/stars (via research-git) + OpenReview/alphaXiv. For benchmark/leaderboard-table lookups, codesota.com (https://codesota.com/) is a community-maintained alternative — not a full replacement but useful for current SOTA table queries.
papers_with_code.status_note: Meta shutdown Jul 2025; paperswithcode.com 301-redirects to HF Trending Papers; GitHub dataset frozen.

curator_newsletters.name: Eugene Yan - eugeneyan.com
curator_newsletters.relevance: Applied ML systems, LLM patterns, evaluation. Author now at Anthropic; posts through May 2026.
curator_newsletters.status_note: Author now at Anthropic; posts through May 2026.

curator_newsletters.name: Latent Space
curator_newsletters.relevance: Applied AI engineering, builder interviews, frameworks.

curator_newsletters.name: Simon Willison - simonwillison.net
curator_newsletters.relevance: LLM tools, prompt injection, applied tinkering with verbose method notes.

curator_newsletters.name: The Batch (DeepLearning.AI)
curator_newsletters.relevance: Weekly digest by Andrew Ng; balanced industry + research coverage.

curator_newsletters.name: Import AI (Jack Clark)
curator_newsletters.relevance: AI policy + research weekly; high signal on emerging systems.

curator_newsletters.name: Chip Huyen - huyenchip.com
curator_newsletters.relevance: ML systems, LLM stack, deployment patterns.

curator_newsletters.name: Andrej Karpathy - karpathy.bearblog.dev
curator_newsletters.relevance: Foundational ML and LLM internals; rare but high signal. URL moved from karpathy.github.io; also at karpathy.substack.com.
curator_newsletters.status_note: URL moved from karpathy.github.io to karpathy.bearblog.dev/blog/ (also karpathy.substack.com).

curator_newsletters.name: Interconnects (Nathan Lambert)
curator_newsletters.relevance: Post-training, RLHF, open-model ecosystem specialist. Deep coverage of alignment fine-tuning, open weights models (Llama, Mistral), and RLHF research. 1–3x/week, high signal.

curator_newsletters.name: Davis Summarizes Papers (Davis Blalock)
curator_newsletters.relevance: Systematic weekly triage of ~600 arXiv ML papers down to 10–20 picks. 10k+ researcher subscribers. Skews ML fundamentals; less coverage of systems or NLP-specific work.

curator_newsletters.name: aimodels.fyi
curator_newsletters.relevance: Maintained paper+model index with follow/alert; tracks lab output across HF/arXiv/GitHub. Useful for watching specific model families.

paper_discovery_tools.name: Emergent Mind
paper_discovery_tools.relevance: arXiv aggregator that cross-references X/Reddit/GitHub traction. Partial Papers-with-Code replacement for method-popularity signal; surfaces papers gaining community traction before formal citation accumulation.

methodology_anchors.name: ACM Reproducibility Badging
methodology_anchors.relevance: Reproducibility grading rubric. Source for evidence-grade rubric in idea-extraction-framework.

methodology_anchors.name: ML Reproducibility Checklist
methodology_anchors.relevance: Pineau et al. checklist used at NeurIPS reviews; canonical reproducibility framing.

commercial_accelerators.name: Elicit
commercial_accelerators.relevance: AI-assisted literature review and evidence synthesis; extracts claims across large paper sets. Useful for rapid systematic review when scanning 100+ papers.
commercial_accelerators.status_note: Re-verified 2026-07-11: Elicit overhauled pricing since the May-2026 sweep. Free Basic tier is now unlimited search/summaries/full-text chat; only Research Agent and Research Reports are usage-capped on Free. Paid Pro is $49/mo (~$588/yr), Scale $169/mo (~$2,028/yr), Enterprise custom. The old '5,000 one-time credits, Plus ~$12/mo' figures are stale — do not cite them. Treat elicit.com/pricing as canonical; third-party aggregator price quotes vary wildly.
commercial_accelerators.cost_tier: Freemium — free unlimited search/summaries/chat, capped Research Agent/Reports; paid Pro $49/mo, Scale $169/mo (verify at elicit.com/pricing)

commercial_accelerators.name: Consensus
commercial_accelerators.relevance: Semantic paper search with evidence quality tags; good for yes/no empirical questions across research.
commercial_accelerators.status_note: Verified May-2026. Freemium: free tier ~unlimited basic searches with capped monthly AI analyses (Pro Analyses / Study Snapshots ~10/mo, Deep Search ~3/mo) — sources disagree on exact caps; paid from ~$10/mo. Verify caps at consensus.app/pricing.
commercial_accelerators.cost_tier: Freemium — free basic searches + capped monthly AI analyses; paid from ~$10/mo (verify caps)
commercial_accelerators.free_alternative: Semantic Scholar Search + manual evidence extraction

commercial_accelerators.name: ResearchRabbit
commercial_accelerators.relevance: Citation graph + email alerts for new papers citing your seed set. Good for tracking a method family without repeated manual searches.
commercial_accelerators.status_note: Re-verified 2026-07-11: acquired by Litmaps on 2025-05-08 (not 2026 — corrected date), relaunched with a freemium (RR+ paid) tier around 2025-10-30/11. Free plan still $0 — unlimited searches, 50-input cap, 1 project, no sharing.
commercial_accelerators.cost_tier: Freemium since Nov 2025 (Litmaps-acquired May 2025) — free plan still $0 (50-input cap, 1 project, no sharing); RR+ paid tier
